name: Shanghai Belling Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Belling Co., Ltd. operates as an integrated circuit design company in China. It offers power management products, including DC/DC step-down, DC/DC step-up, and charge pump DC/DC step-up converter, load switch, voltage detector/reset IC, SSR, bipolar type and CMOS type LDO linear regulator, three-terminal positive regulator, li-ion battery charger, shunt regulator, and PSR; and measurement of IC of IOT and power sensor SoC.
